prompt:
Use case: photorealistic visual learning asset for the Hanzi 蝶; subject ID butterfly only.
Primary request: one vertical 1024x1792 photographic triptych with exactly three independent horizontal landscape photographs stacked top to bottom, separated by two narrow straight white horizontal seams approximately 8 pixels thick near y=597 and y=1195. No outer border.
Top photograph: one orange-and-black butterfly naturally perched on a meadow flower with both pairs of wings fully spread open, viewed from above at a gentle angle. Its complete symmetrical wings, body and antennae are visible.
Middle photograph: one orange-and-black butterfly perched naturally on a meadow flower with its wings closed together upright, photographed side-on. Clearly show the closed-wing side silhouette, antennae and small legs touching the flower, not a second open-wing view.
Bottom photograph: one orange-and-black butterfly in natural flight in the air above a softly blurred meadow, wings open in a plausible flying position, body and legs suspended with nothing touching them. The entire butterfly, including antennae and wing tips, is visible.
Composition/framing: three standalone wide landscape nature macro photographs in exactly this order: open wings, closed wings, flying. One butterfly centered per panel with at least 12 percent safe margins around its entire silhouette, antennae and wings. Each cropped panel remains a complete independent photo.
Style/medium: authentic photorealistic nature photography, delicate wing scale textures and veins, natural antennae and anatomically plausible six legs, realistic flower textures, soft natural daylight, true-to-life colors and gentle depth of field.
Constraints: natural safe animal observation; no people, hands, capture, feeding, bait, approach or anthropomorphism; no clothing or artificial props. Exactly three panels, two white seams. No writing, captions, labels, letters, numbers, logos, cartoon, illustration, watermark or decorative graphics.
reviewNotes: Inspected only the 300x525 JPEG preview. Top shows an orange-and-black butterfly with wings fully open on a pink flower; middle shows an upright closed-wing side view on small white flowers; bottom shows a butterfly airborne with wings angled open. All wing tips remain inside the panels. Top antennae and middle upper wing have less than the requested 12 percent vertical margin, but remain clear of the crop boundaries. Wing patterns and natural meadow lighting are visible; exact leg counts and fine details are not verified at this resolution. No visible people, handling, writing or watermark. Sharp measured white seam rows 588–597 and 1188–1197 in the 1024x1792 source; rounded centers 593 and 1193.
